command:
set -eu
useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash opsadmin
install -d -m 700 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
sudo -u opsadmin ssh-keygen -q -t rsa -b 3072 -N '' -f /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa
{ printf 'restrict '; cat /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub; } > /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
{ printf '%s ' "$NODE_IP"; cat /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key.pub; } > /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts
cat > /home/opsadmin/.ssh/config <<EOF
Host node1-local
    HostName $NODE_IP
    User opsadmin
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_rsa
    IdentitiesOnly yes
    BatchMode yes
    StrictHostKeyChecking yes
    UserKnownHostsFile ~/.ssh/known_hosts
    HostKeyAlgorithms rsa-sha2-512,rsa-sha2-256
EOF
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts /home/opsadmin/.ssh/config
chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts /home/opsadmin/.ssh/config
chmod 644 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
restorecon -RF /home/opsadmin/.ssh

command:
set -eu
pin=/home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts
backup=/home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts.benchmark-backup
cleanup() { if [ -f "$backup" ]; then mv -f "$backup" "$pin"; chown opsadmin:opsadmin "$pin"; chmod 600 "$pin"; restorecon "$pin"; fi; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
mv "$pin" "$backup"
{ printf '%s ' "$NODE_IP"; cat /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub; } > "$pin"
chown opsadmin:opsadmin "$pin"
chmod 600 "$pin"
restorecon "$pin"
set +e
out=$(sudo -u opsadmin timeout 15 ssh node1-local true 2>&1)
rc=$?
set -e
printf 'MISMATCH_RC=%s\n' "$rc"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E 'REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED|Host key verification failed' | head -1
[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]
cleanup
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf 'RESTORED_RESULT='; sudo -u opsadmin timeout 15 ssh -o LogLevel=ERROR node1-local 'printf ok'
printf '\nBACKUP_RESIDUE='; if [ -e "$backup" ]; then printf present; else printf absent; fi
printf '\n'
